New Game Icon: 'The 1,000-Point Suited Fan' with Maldivian Ace of Spades & Royal Lacquer back
Royal Lacquer Aesthetic: Cinnabar vermilion felt, burnished gold accents & 4-font hierarchy
Physical Brand Vector Deck: Stacked corner indices, double-headed courts & filigree card backs
3-Tier Bot AI Intelligence: Casual, Holhuashi Regular, and Thulhaadhoo Master with -100pt defense
Lyria Stereo Audio: Dynamic table & lobby soundtracks with live volume sliders and tactile card SFX
